        "flows": [[1, 2, -1, 3]],
        "groups": [],
        "windows": [[0, 0, 5, 1, 1, 0, 5, [[0, 0]] * 9]],
    }],
}


def variant(mutate, raw=None):
    if raw is not None:

    data = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
    mutate(data)
    return json.dumps(data).encode()

    return data['cases'][0]
